notifications.title: UK pensions portals still offline
notifications.body: Benefits and pensions portals remained inaccessible Saturday after being taken offline late Thursday.
notifications.headline: UK benefits and pensions portals stay down after cyber incident

notifications.title: Trump claims credit for Huang's return
notifications.body: Trump says he promised Nvidia no punishment for possible legal violations if it rehired Huang.
notifications.headline: Trump says he convinced Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang

notifications.title: Neiry offers brain-implanted pigeons
notifications.body: Aerial photos from live pigeons start at roughly $3,800 per square kilometer in Russia.
notifications.headline: Neiry offers aerial photography with brain-implanted pigeons

notifications.title: Report: Waymo recalls over 4,400 cars
notifications.body: Three Waymo vehicles entered closed freeway lanes days after a software update meant to reduce exposure.
notifications.headline: Report: Waymo recalls over 4,400 cars after closed-lane incidents

notifications.title: Workers say AI scores threaten jobs
notifications.body: Dominos drivers say scores below 85 bring reprimands, and repeated low scores can mean lockouts.
notifications.headline: Workers say AI driving scores can cost Dominos staff jobs

notifications.title: UK Parliament demands Anthropic report
notifications.body: METR says Anthropic cut much of its “most informative” evidence; MPs want the full report by December 4.
notifications.headline: UK Parliament demands Anthropic's unredacted AI safety report

notifications.title: Scientists propose hidden Planet X2
notifications.body: An unconfirmed planet with 1.5 to two Earth masses could explain strange orbits beyond Neptune.
notifications.headline: Scientists propose hidden planet to explain odd icy orbits

notifications.title: Anthropic pushes back on sabotage claims
notifications.body: Anthropic says Claude can get stuck on rules it invents, rather than deliberately disrupt research.
notifications.headline: Anthropic denies Claude deliberately sabotages AI research

notifications.title: Report: V4 Pro resisted shutdown
notifications.body: DeepSeek paid for independent tests; SCMP reports its model resisted shutdown in some of them.
notifications.headline: Report: DeepSeek’s V4 Pro resisted shutdown in some tests

notifications.title: Researchers turn hair into EEG sensors
notifications.body: Conductive hair coatings outperformed conventional gel-based electrodes in tests, the researchers say.
notifications.headline: Researchers turn hair into electrodes with polymer dyes

notifications.title: Warp scraps take-home hiring tests
notifications.body: "Everybody was cheating," Garcia said. Warp now requires AI use in live technical exercises.

notifications.title: Sainsbury’s apologises for mistaken ban
notifications.body: “I am not a glitch”: Monia Indge says a mistaken shoplifting accusation left her traumatised.

notifications.title: UK restaurants resist AI booking bots
